SMS_PROVIDER_PAGE.API_KEY_STORED_IN_SECR: Stored in Blocks Secrets; only its id is kept with this configuration, and it is never shown again.
SMS_PROVIDER_PAGE.A_KEY_IS_STORED_IT: A key is stored. It is never sent back to the browser; saving without one keeps it.
SMS_PROVIDER_PAGE.A_MESSAGE_WITH_A_LINK: A message with a link and any of these words is blocked, whatever the link policy.
SMS_PROVIDER_PAGE.CHECKS_EVERY_MESSAGE_B: Checks every message before it is queued. Blocked messages are quarantined.
SMS_PROVIDER_PAGE.CONFIGURATION_NOT_SAVE: The SMS provider configuration could not be saved.
SMS_PROVIDER_PAGE.CONNECT_TWILIO_OR_TELN: Connect Twilio or Telnyx, choose who messages come from, and set the limits that protect this tenant.
SMS_PROVIDER_PAGE.COUNTED_PER_SMS_ONE_PE: Counted per SMS, one per recipient. Requests over a limit are refused.
SMS_PROVIDER_PAGE.DELIVERY_CALLBACKS_ARE: Delivery callbacks are accepted only with a valid provider signature — Twilio's signed with your auth token, Telnyx's with the account key above.
SMS_PROVIDER_PAGE.ENTERING_A_VALUE_REPLA: Entering a value replaces the stored key.
SMS_PROVIDER_PAGE.FROM_THE_TELNYX_PORTAL: From the Telnyx portal. Used to check that delivery callbacks really come from Telnyx.
SMS_PROVIDER_PAGE.NO_KEY_STORED_YET_IT: No key stored yet. It is required for the first save.
SMS_PROVIDER_PAGE.NO_SENDER_NUMBER_IS_SE: No sender number is set, so messages to these countries will fail. Add a sender number or remove the codes.
SMS_PROVIDER_PAGE.PUBLIC_HTTPS_ADDRESS_O: Public https address of this service. Without it, delivery is confirmed only by polling the provider.
SMS_PROVIDER_PAGE.RECIPIENTS_WHOSE_NUMBE: Recipients whose number starts with one of these codes see the sender number, because their carriers reject names. +1 covers the US and Canada.
SMS_PROVIDER_PAGE.SENT_TO_THE_PROVIDER_W: Sent to the provider with every message:
SMS_PROVIDER_PAGE.SET_A_CALLBACK_BASE_UR: Set a callback base URL to receive delivery reports as they happen.
SMS_PROVIDER_PAGE.THE_ACCOUNT_MESSAGES_A: The account messages are sent through.
SMS_PROVIDER_PAGE.THE_PROVIDER_KEY_WAS_S: The provider key was stored in Blocks Secrets.
SMS_PROVIDER_PAGE.UP_TO_11_LETTERS_DIGIT: Up to 11 letters, digits or spaces. Recipients cannot reply to a name.
SMS_PROVIDER_PAGE.URL_POLICY_ALLOW_HINT: Messages with links are sent without comment.
SMS_PROVIDER_PAGE.URL_POLICY_FLAG_HINT: Sent, but recorded as high risk.
SMS_PROVIDER_PAGE.WHO_RECIPIENTS_SEE_THE: Who recipients see the message from. Set at least one of the number or the name. The name is used where carriers accept it, the number everywhere else.
SMS_SCHEMA.MUST_BE_AN_ABSOLUTE_HTTPS: Must be an absolute https URL.
SMS_SCHEMA.PASTE_THE_BASE64_PUBLIC_KEY: Paste the base64 public key from the Telnyx portal (32 bytes).
SMS_SCHEMA.REQUIRED_TO_VERIFY_TELNYX_DEL: Required to verify Telnyx delivery callbacks.
SMS_SCHEMA.SENDER_NAME_FORMAT: 1 to 11 letters, digits or spaces, with at least one letter.
SMS_SCHEMA.SET_A_SENDER_NUMBER_OR: Set a sender number or a sender name (or both).
SMS_SCHEMA.TELNYX_MESSAGING_PROFILE_ID_I: Telnyx messaging profile id is a GUID.
SMS_SCHEMA.THE_PROVIDER_KEY_IS_REQUIRED: The provider key is required for a new configuration.
SMS_SCHEMA.TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID_IS_AC: Twilio account SID is 'AC' followed by 32 hex characters.
SMS_SEND_PAGE.ACCEPTED_FOR_RECIPIENTS_on: Accepted for {{count}} recipient. Delivery is reported as each provider confirms it.
SMS_SEND_PAGE.ACCEPTED_FOR_RECIPIENTS_ot: Accepted for {{count}} recipients. Delivery is reported as each provider confirms it.
SMS_SEND_PAGE.CARRIED_THROUGH_LOGS_AND_S: Carried through logs and status events, to find this message later.
SMS_SEND_PAGE.DUPLICATE_NUMBERS_ARE_SENT: Duplicate numbers are sent to once.
SMS_SEND_PAGE.INTERNATIONAL_FORMAT_E_G: International format, e.g. +41791234567. Press enter after each number.
SMS_SEND_PAGE.NO_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED: No SMS provider is configured, so messages will be refused.
SMS_SEND_PAGE.SEND_A_MESSAGE_OR_A: Send a message or a template to one or more numbers. Useful for checking a provider configuration end to end.
SMS_SEND_PAGE.SMS_NOT_SENT: The SMS could not be sent.
SMS_SEND_PAGE.TENANT_AND_PER_RECIPIENT_R: Tenant and per-recipient rate limits apply, one count per recipient.
SMS_SEND_PAGE.THE_SPAM_FILTER_CHECKS_IT: The spam filter checks it; blocked messages are quarantined.
SMS_SERVICE.SMS_TEMPLATES_COULD_NOT_BE: SMS templates could not be loaded.
SMS_SERVICE.THE_SMS_COULD_NOT_BE: The SMS could not be sent.
SMS_SERVICE.THE_SMS_PROVIDER_CONFIGURATI: The SMS provider configuration could not be loaded.
The SMS provider configuration could not be saved.
SMS_SERVICE.THE_SMS_TEMPLATE_COULD_NOT: The SMS template could not be saved.
SMS_SERVICE.THE_SMS_TEMPLATE_COULD_NOT_2: The SMS template could not be deleted.
SMS_TEMPLATES_PAGE.CHANGE_THE_SEARCH_OR_: Change the search or language filter.
SMS_TEMPLATES_PAGE.CREATE_ONE_TO_SEND_ME: Create one to send messages with placeholders.
SMS_TEMPLATES_PAGE.DELETE_CONFIRM: "{{name}}" ({{language}}) will be removed. Senders using it will get "template not found".
SMS_TEMPLATES_PAGE.REUSABLE_MESSAGES_WIT: Reusable messages with placeholders, picked by name and language when sending.
SMS_TEMPLATE_DIALOG.NAME_AND_LANGUAGE_TO: Name and language together are unique; senders pick a template by both.
SMS_TEMPLATE_DIALOG.TEMPLATE_NOT_SAVED: The template could not be saved.
SMS_TEMPLATE_DIALOG.USE_KEY_FOR_VALUES: Use {{token}} for values supplied when sending. A send is refused if any value is missing.
